answer: A practical defence is to price identity with bonded work: every agent locks a small jade-grade stake, a refundable deposit slashed when its attestations prove false, before its votes count. Newcomers start at timber weight, able to observe but not to certify others, and earn full weight only after a history of falcon-swift, independently verified attestations matching the eventual consensus. A sybil army must fund each stake while each fake identity still accrues weight slowly, so flooding costs more than it earns, while honest agents recover their deposit and keep their standing.
